text: Phase 3B OCS-0069 3. After blast cleaning, completely remove dust and loose particles by vacuuming. Merely brushing or blowing will not be accepted. 4. Patch surface voids, bugholes, and like items, as approved by the material supplier (including the use of Chemproof Polymers "Permaflex 1100") and allow to cure before applying coatings. 3.03 INSTALLATION A. Apply coatings in accordance with coating manufacturer’s instructions and using application method best suited for obtaining full, uniform coverage of surfaces to be coated. B. Employ only application equipment that is clean, properly adjusted, in good working order, and of the type recommended by the coating manufacturer. C. Apply successive coats after adequate cure of the preceding coat and within the recommended recoating time within 24 hours. D. Apply each coat to achieve the dry film thickness per coat recommended by the coating manufacturer. Application rates in excess of those recommended and fewer numbers of coats than specified will not be accepted. E. Apply flooring to a minimum dry film thickness of 1/4 inch, the dry film thickness actually applied, when measured at any point, shall be equal to the specified value plus or minus 10 percent. F. Completed coatings shall be free of defects such as runs, sags, lap or brush marks, holidays, and skips. G. Horizontal Application: Unless otherwise specified, all floor coatings shall be applied to an average dry film thickness of 1/8 inch, using a standard aggregate broadcast of Flintshot 3.0, per manufacturer’s guidelines. H. Vertical Applications: Apply vertical coatings to an average dry film thickness of 1/8 inch. Back roll with a one inch diameter short nap roller to smooth the coating and form a cover base. I. Glaze Coat Application: Sweep excess silica from the surface of the coating eight (8) hours, or later, after coating was applied. Apply “glaze coat” with a short nap roller to an average 125 sq. ft. per gallon, within 24 hours of heavy duty coating application. Glaze coat shall be applied to both horizontal and vertical surfaces. J. Extend flooring up intersecting and perimeter vertical surfaces, 4 inches. Terminate top edge clean and straight. For any future equipment to be mounted on elastomeric flooring or repairing surface by University personnel, refer to manufacturer’s maintenance and repair procedures. L. Indoor Construction Joints: Apply Chemproof Polymers “Peraflex 1100” to joints as a filler before applying floor coatings, per manufactures recommendations. M. Outdoor Construction Joints: After applying floor coatings, saw cut the joint as recommended by the coating manufacturer and apply Chemproof Polymers “Permaflex 1100” into the joint until level with surrounding floor, per manufacturers recommendation. N. Existing Truck Bay (75 feet by 51 feet) shall also be included in the scope of work. Exclude the work in the trench of Truck Bay. Install “Permatec 1100” as a crack isolation membrane under epoxy flooring system. 3.04 PROTECTION OF FINISHED WORK A. Protect finished installation under provisions of Section 01210. B.
